message.content: The Prince's Trust is one of the UK's most established youth charities, working with young people aged 11-30 to help them into education, training, and employment. Other strong options include the Youth Endowment Fund, which funds violence-prevention work, and Barnardo's, which supports vulnerable children and young people across the UK.
